title: FTP server restarts on its own after being turned off and the app is dismissed from Recents

full_report.title: FTP server restarts on its own after being turned off and the app is dismissed from Recents
full_report.observed_behavior: On the FTP server screen, if the user turns the FTP server off, presses Back, and dismisses the app from the Recents screen, the FTP server restarts on its own.
full_report.expected_behavior: The FTP server should not restart on its own.
full_report.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Open the app and allow the storage permission.
2. On the Files screen, tap the Navigate up button.
3. In the navigation drawer, tap FTP server.
4. On the FTP server screen, turn the Status switch off.
5. Press the Back button to leave the app.
6. Open the Recents screen.
7. Dismiss the Files app from Recents.

ground_truth.info_elements_gt:
Buggy Behavior: the server restarts automatically
Triggering GUI Interaction: stops the FTP server and then closes the app
Triggering Screen Reference: FTP server screen
Correct Behavior: The FTP server should remain stopped
